title: Climate Risk Intelligence - Mobile
prompt:
Generate the mobile responsive 'Risk Intelligence' screen for ClimateGuard AI.
SHELL: Use mobile_tab shell for 'Risk Intel' with active tab highlight on 'Risk Intel'.

CONTENT REQUIREMENTS (strictly structured for mobile portrait viewport ~390px):
1. TOP SELECTION CONTROLS:
   - Screen Title: 'Risk Intelligence' with 'Inference Live' cyan status pill.
   - Subtitle: 'Multi-hazard predictive synthesis & calibrated exposure'.
   - Location Selector dropdown: 'Indus Basin & Thar Corridor (Zone 43N)'.
   - Filter chips / horizontal scroll pills: 'All Hazards', 'Flood (Critical)', 'Heat (High)', 'Drought (Moderate)'.
   - Forecast Horizon Selector: Segmented pill buttons ('24h', '48h (Rec)', '7d', '14d').
   - Action Button: Full-width electric cyan 'Run Risk Analysis' button with icon.

2. THREE HAZARD CARDS (Vertical stacked mobile-first cards):
   - FLOOD RISK CARD (Card with subtle border and #EF4444 left accent):
     - Header: Flood icon, 'Flood Inundation Risk', Badge: 'CRITICAL (88%)' in Red #EF4444.
     - Primary metric: 14,200 m³/s river discharge (+18.3% over 10-yr threshold of 12,000 m³/s).
     - Secondary metrics: 68.4 mm precip / 24h, +1.80m gauge anomaly.
     - Contributing Factors: Glacial melt (42%), Monsoonal convergence (38%), Soil saturation limit (20%).
     - Model: Hydro-Net v3.2. Status: Pre-Breach Warning.
   - HEATWAVE RISK CARD (Border with #F97316 left accent):
     - Header: Sun icon, 'Extreme Heatwave Risk', Badge: 'HIGH ANOMALY (76%)' in Orange #F97316.
     - Primary metric: 46.2°C ambient / 31.8°C WBGT (+6.4°C vs seasonal baseline).
     - Secondary metrics: Night min temp 33.5°C, 78.4% RH.
     - Contributing Factors: 500hPa Heat dome (55%), Low radiative cooling (25%), Albedo trapping (20%).
     - Model: ThermoWatch v2.1.
   - DROUGHT / ARIDITY RISK CARD (Border with #EAB308 left accent):
     - Header: Drought icon, 'Agricultural Drought Deficit', Badge: 'MODERATE (64%)' in Yellow #EAB308.
     - Primary metric: -41.0% Root Zone Soil Moisture (45 rain-free days).
     - Secondary metrics: NDVI deviation -0.32, Evapotranspiration 7.2 mm/d.
     - Contributing Factors: Monsoonal delay (60%), Aquifer drawdown (25%), VPD elevation (15%).
     - Model: AridScan v4.0.

3. FORECAST PROBABILITY & TRAJECTORY CHART (Mobile optimized):
   - Title: '7-Day Multi-Hazard Forecast Trajectory'
   - Clean SVG line chart displaying Discharge (Red/Cyan curve) rising above the Parametric Breach Band (> 12,000 m³/s), alongside ambient temperature (orange) with historical reference point.
   - Historical Comparison badge: 'Exceeds 2010 Super-Flood baseline by +4.2%'.

4. SHAP ATTRIBUTION & FEATURE SENSITIVITY:
   - Compact progress bars showing key model weights:
     - Upstream Precipitation Volume: 0.38
     - Antecedent Soil Saturation: 0.28
     - Surface Radiative Heating: 0.18
     - Barometric Pressure Gradient: 0.16

5. EXPLAINABLE RISK & AUTOMATED PROTOCOL CARDS:
   - Algorithmic Narrative: Concise summary highlighting compound stress of monsoonal moisture meeting extreme glacial melt in Sector 43N.
   - Parametric Trigger Alert Banner: 'CG-FIN-9821 Primed: Capital Pool Escrow $24,500,000 USD'.
   - Quick Action buttons: 'Dispatch Evacuation Notice', 'Deploy Dyke Barriers', 'Sign Multisig Escrow'.

6. DATA PROVENANCE & TIMESTAMPS:
   - Providers: Open-Meteo, NASA MODIS, Copernicus ERA5.
   - Timestamp: 'Generated 2026-10-24 14:32 UTC • Model #INF-8849-C01 • Confidence: 96.8%'.

DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS:
- Strict alignment with ClimateGuard AI dark theme: #07111F, #0B1728, #101F33, #162840, #24364B border.
- Risk colors: Safe #22C55E, Moderate #EAB308, High #F97316, Critical #EF4444, Accent #22D3EE.
- Mobile friendly touch targets (min 44px), readable typography, no horizontal page overflow.
